ns2:course.label: Principles of Composition
ns2:course.description: Intermediate level. Practice in exposition, with emphasis on organization, paragraphing, and sentence structure. For the student whose career will require competence in writing clear, precise prose as an adjunct to another professional activity. Credit is not given for both RHET 233 and RHET 243. Prerequisite: Completion of campus Composition I general education requirement.
